messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-2026-4321 for hosted-inference-prod - spike in 5xx errors on /v1/generate (service: model-serving-1). Primary on-call did not ack within 3m. Escalation policy: primary -> secondary -> manager.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation: paging secondary @Miguel C. (5m since initial page). Notes: error-rate = 62% over last 2m, affected region: us-west-2.

Sara L.: I'm on mobile, seeing the pings but can't reach laptop. marking as trying-to-ack. @Miguel can you take if you can VPN in? :wave:

Miguel C.: acked. Jumping in now. any immediate mitigation ideas? looks like model-serving-1 instances showing OOMs and 502s, maybe bad quantized model roll.

Alex R.: +1 on rollback suspicion — we rolled quantized v2.3 to a canary yesterday. Canary traffic looked ok but not same seq lengths. I’m pulling recent deploys.

Tim B.: Incident timeline: 00:00 alert -> primary no ack -> 00:05 secondary paged -> 00:09 manager paged (auto) because secondary reported but not confirmed fix.

pagerduty-bot: Manager escalation: paging @Sara L. (manager) due to no remediation confirmation within 8m.

Sara L.: On it. I can join a quick bridge. Creating incident room. bridge: https://meet.redwood/incident-4321 (ops only).

Miguel C.: quick mitigation: I'm going to scale down model-serving-1 replicas to reduce OOM churn and re-route 20% traffic to model-serving-2 (stable). Command: ```kubectl -n inference scale deployment model-serving-1 --replicas=4``` and ```trafficctl shift --from model-serving-1 --to model-serving-2 --pct 20```

Alex R.: I'm preparing a revert of the quantized v2.3 canary. If we revert the canary manifest it should stop the bad path for new pods. Applying revert now: ```git revert -m 1 deploys/quantized-v2.3 && k apply -f deploys/quantized-v2.3/revert.yaml```

Tim B.: Noted: customer-facing impact: some production customers seeing 5xx for generation and timeouts for long prompts. ETA to full mitigation if traffic shift & scale successful: ~6-9 minutes.

Miguel C.: scaled down + traffic shift applied. error-rate dropping to 18% now. still seeing a couple hosts with crash loops, marking them cordoned.

Sara L.: Good call. I'm going to disable the automatic canary rollout for quantized models until we validate seq-length perf. Flagging this as a postmortem item.

pagerduty-bot: Update: INC-2026-4321 status: acknowledged by Miguel C., partial mitigation in progress. Manager @Sara L. marked incident severity S2.

Alex R.: Revert completed, old (stable) model has healthy pods. I'll watch for memory regression.

Tim B.: Customer comms: draft sent to SRE-Support for review — "We experienced elevated 5xx errors on model generation. We've rerouted traffic and reverted a recent model rollout; systems are recovering. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline."

Sara L.: Final note: manager escalation fired appropriately when secondary couldn't confirm a remediation earlier. We should tweak escalation timing: reduce manager escalate window to 10m for same-service high-5xx alerts. Adding to ops backlog. Thanks all, closing the emergency handoff once error-rate <5% for 15m. :white_check_mark:
